title: Data Analyst roadmap
description: From spreadsheets and SQL to analysis that decision-makers trust.

provenance.method: Stages follow the order in which each skill is normally needed on the job; targets for skills the career already requires come from that career's requirement rows, and the rest are set by Capabilio to be reachable by a final-year student.
provenance.notes: Original tree. Designed from first principles and the canonical skill taxonomy; not derived from any third-party roadmap.

nodes.title: Spreadsheet Formulas and Functions
nodes.description: Builds reliable calculations with lookup, logical, text and date functions. Most first analyses at work happen in a spreadsheet.

nodes.title: Pivot Tables
nodes.description: Summarises large tables by category and period using pivot tables and charts. The fastest way to summarise a table by category and period.

nodes.title: Spreadsheet modelling
nodes.description: Builds and checks analysis models in a spreadsheet. The career expects reliable, checkable spreadsheet models.

nodes.title: SQL Query Basics
nodes.description: Retrieves and filters rows with SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT. Most business data lives in databases, not files.

nodes.title: SQL Joins
nodes.description: Combines tables with inner and outer joins and reasons about row counts after a join. Useful questions almost always need more than one table.

nodes.title: SQL Aggregation and Grouping
nodes.description: Summarises data with aggregate functions, GROUP BY and HAVING. Most analysis is a summary by some category.

nodes.title: SQL Subqueries and CTEs
nodes.description: Structures multi-step queries with subqueries and common table expressions. Lets you break a hard question into readable steps.

nodes.title: SQL Window Functions
nodes.description: Computes rankings, running totals and comparisons across rows without collapsing them. Rankings, running totals and period comparisons.

nodes.title: SQL in practice
nodes.description: Queries and shapes relational data with SQL. The career expects fluent SQL.

nodes.title: Handling Missing Values
nodes.description: Detects missing data, understands why it is missing and chooses to drop, fill or flag it. Missing data silently changes results if ignored.

nodes.title: Deduplication and Standardization
nodes.description: Finds duplicate records and makes inconsistent text, dates and categories uniform. Duplicates and inconsistent labels inflate and split counts.

nodes.title: Data Validation Checks
nodes.description: Defines and runs checks that catch impossible, inconsistent or out-of-range data before analysis. Catches impossible values before they reach a report.

nodes.title: Data cleaning in practice
nodes.description: Turns messy raw data into data that is safe to analyse. The career expects you to leave data better than you found it.

nodes.title: Descriptive Statistics
nodes.description: Summarises data with centre, spread and shape, and chooses measures that suit the data. The first step of any analysis.

nodes.title: Random Variables and Distributions
nodes.description: Describes uncertain quantities with common distributions and computes expectations. Explains why data is shaped the way it is.

nodes.title: Sampling and Confidence Intervals
nodes.description: Draws conclusions about a population from a sample and states the uncertainty. Lets you say how sure you are from a sample.

nodes.title: Hypothesis Testing
nodes.description: Tests a claim with a null hypothesis, a test statistic and a p-value, and states what the result means. Separates a real difference from chance.

nodes.title: Correlation and Regression Basics
nodes.description: Measures how variables move together and fits a simple line while avoiding causal over-claims. Measures relationships, with care about cause.

nodes.title: Conditional Probability and Bayes' Rule
nodes.description: Updates beliefs with new evidence using conditional probability and Bayes' rule. Helps with tests, screening and risk questions.

nodes.title: Statistics in practice
nodes.description: Uses data to describe, compare and draw careful conclusions. The career expects sound statistical judgement.

nodes.title: Python
nodes.description: Writes clear, working programs in Python. The standard tool when data outgrows a spreadsheet.

nodes.title: NumPy Arrays
nodes.description: Computes on whole arrays at once with vectorised operations, broadcasting and indexing. Fast numeric computing underneath the data tools.

nodes.title: Data Wrangling with Pandas
nodes.description: Loads, reshapes, joins and summarises tabular data with pandas. Cleaning and reshaping tables is most of the work.

nodes.title: Data Visualization with Python
nodes.description: Plots distributions and relationships with Python libraries and labels them clearly. Plot as you explore, not only at the end.

nodes.title: Chart Selection
nodes.description: Picks the chart that shows a comparison, trend, part-to-whole or relationship honestly. The wrong chart hides or exaggerates the point.

nodes.title: Dashboard Design
nodes.description: Lays out a dashboard so the main question is answered at a glance and filters stay simple. A dashboard should answer a question at a glance.

nodes.title: KPI and Metric Definition
nodes.description: Defines a metric precisely, with its formula, grain and exclusions, so everyone reads it the same way. Numbers mean nothing until everyone defines them the same way.

nodes.title: Business intelligence in practice
nodes.description: Builds dashboards and reports that people use to make decisions. The career expects you to build reports others rely on.

nodes.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
nodes.description: Explores a new dataset to understand its shape, quality and patterns before modelling or reporting. Understanding a new dataset comes before any claim about it.

nodes.title: A/B Test Analysis
nodes.description: Designs and reads a controlled experiment, including sample size, significance and practical effect. Experiments are how businesses learn what works.

nodes.title: Cohort and Funnel Analysis
nodes.description: Tracks groups over time and step-by-step drop-off to explain retention and conversion. Explains retention and where users drop off.

nodes.title: Data analysis in practice
nodes.description: Turns data into answers: asks a question, explores, tests and explains. The career expects you to take a question from ask to answer.

nodes.title: Data Storytelling
nodes.description: Turns analysis into a clear message for a decision-maker, with the evidence and the caveats. Findings only matter if the audience acts on them.

nodes.title: Technical communication
nodes.description: Explains technical work clearly to the people who need it. Clear writing and speaking about technical work.

nodes.title: Version control for analysis
nodes.description: Tracks and shares changes to code so a team can work together safely. Makes analysis shareable and reproducible.
